purpose: Video research actually performed for the machines and transport refurbishment, and what it could not cover.

access.direct_youtube: Blocked. yt-dlp, youtube-transcript-api and a real browser all return a bot or unusual traffic page for this network, and each request to youtu.be or youtube.com/watch was refused.
access.piped_and_invidious: Blocked. Four public mirrors returned 403 or 500 for the same video id.
access.workaround_used: youtubetotranscript.com read through the web extractor, which fetches server side and is not blocked. The extractor returns only the opening portion of each transcript, roughly two to four thousand characters, so only the start of each video could be read.
access.not_used: Browser cookies were not read and no account was used for YouTube access.

videos_read.title: Getting Started in Create Aeronautics
claims_used: A body starts as a single block: assemble it first, then build the rest onto the assembled block
The physics assembler turns a block into a physics object and its crafting path runs through andesite alloy and a casing
Small bodies can be punched around; larger ones are moved with an iron handle on sneak use
Diagonal steps stay connected; a fully disconnected part breaks off as its own body
videos_read.limit: Read to the first few minutes only. Numbers and later block detail were not seen.

videos_read.title: Speed, Stress and Power Explained
claims_used: Engineer's goggles show the stress and speed a component carries
The speedometer and stressometer are built from an andesite casing and a compass and convert into each other
A water wheel needs flowing water on one of its sides to turn
videos_read.limit: Read to the first few minutes only. Per-machine stress costs were already taken from pack configuration instead.

videos_read.reason_not_used: The telescope, astronomy table, rocket station and jet engine in this video are not present in the selected cosmonautics 26.08.307 jar, so the workflow describes a different space mod. Nothing from it was written into the guide.
